name: Pylon
description: Drops an orbital pylon onto any tile on the map. Each one fires alongside this unit whenever it casts Orbital Beam.
details: Pylons can be attacked but never block movement.
A destroyed pylon detonates for %death_damage% damage to adjacent enemies, stunning them for %death_duration% turn.

upgrade.summary: Cooldown cut to %cooldown% turn - a pylon almost every turn.
